verification_scope.word: DOC and DOT retain one Macros/VBA storage with ThisDocument and NewMacros candidates, PROJECT/PROJECTwm, required dir/_VBA_PROJECT and four SRP names. The Project project declares code page 10000, module offsets 931/1420, document-class/procedural kinds and clear private/read-only flags. The exact ASCII source is 277/456 LF-delimited bytes. Reference names are MSForms, Normal and Office; licenses and designer frames are absent.
verification_scope.legacy_excel: XLS and XLT retain _VBA_PROJECT_CUR/VBA, consistent ObProj/storage/ObNoMacros presence, no saved host code names, Module1 and four SRP names. The VBAProject project uses page 10000 and procedural Module1 at offset 1428 with exact 428-byte LF source and MSForms/Office references.
verification_scope.ooxml_excel: XLSM, XLTM and XLSB expose rId5 from their exact workbook owner to /xl/vbaProject.bin. The native 10,752-byte payload hashes and project GUIDs are pinned. XLSB declares no project signatures. Decoded module text and reference/name-map metadata match the legacy project expectations.
verification_scope.limits: Native module-count refusal is checked through format wrappers and after warming PROJECT/PROJECTwm caches. A 10,751-byte CFB budget rejects the 10,752-byte native payload. Aggregate source limits 733/428 admit the Word/Excel source exactly; one byte less returns TotalSourceBytes during bounded decompression.
verification_scope.source_edits: A DOC first-paragraph edit preserves every unrelated CFB stream, including complete VBA storage/caches, and exact source inverse. An XLS B2 value edit changes only Workbook and restores original bytes through inverse. Both save/reopen and reparse complete native VBA source.
verification_scope.project_lifecycle: Reinserting each same native project is byte-exact no-op. Removal changes only the VBA member and relevant manifests; XLSM/XLTM main content types become the corresponding nonmacro sheet/template type, while XLSB retains its fixed binary type. Replacement uses another existing native Excel project payload, preserving unrelated members, all content types and relationship IDs/targets/modes. Reopened inverse restores every original member.
verification_scope.codec_reference_edit: The unedited dir serializer returns exact original compressed bytes. Renaming the Office display reference to OfficeInspection preserves project name/page, module records, reference kinds and every other reference raw record after decoding; the immutable original project still supplies an exact no-op.
verification_scope.limitations: No VBA compilation, interpretation or execution, no type-library resolution, no external access, no signature trust decision, no native Office reopen and no template-instantiation claim. Recorded module bodies are ASCII under Mac code page 10000; other code pages and non-ASCII native source are not qualified. Legacy project replacement/removal and containing-document publication of the reference-name edit remain outside these assertions.
